text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up: rolling a conservative packing policy canary. saw p99 tail from continuous-batcher creep on some tenants. want to keep discussion / decisions here.
Ajay Patel: which knobs are we flipping for the canary?
Maria Chen: two changes: reduce global buffer to 25ms, add a lightweight tenant pack-score that biases window extension for stable-tenants.
Samir Rao: how do we compute pack-score w/o per-tenant memory churn? last time per-tenant maps blew up during spikes.
Priya Nair: use coarse buckets: tenant_tier + recent throughput band (low/med/high). maintain EWMA per-bucket, not per-tenant. very low state.
Ajay Patel: buckets make sense. fallback if bucket state stale: default to no-extension. avoids accidental long waits.
Maria Chen: eviction semantics: stitch map TTL 400ms + LRU cap 4k entries/worker. when full, evict LRU and tag evicted tenants with header stitch-by=evicted so runtime fast-path skips packing.
Samir Rao: add metric stitch.evicted_count and stitch.bypass_rate. also emit label evict_cause (cap|ttl|manual) for quick drilldowns.
Priya Nair: observability: histograms for wait_before_pack_ms by bucket and worker. that'll show if any worker outliers exist.
Ajay Patel: ops risk: packing improves token-efficiency but can increase early-request latency. we should track pack_gain_per_request and p95_latency_delta.
Maria Chen: rollout plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% if pack_gain > 2% and p99_delta < 15ms. abort on SLA breach.
Samir Rao: implementation note: make pack-score adjustable via feature flag and keep default disabled for new tenants until warmed. avoids cold-tenant penalty.
Priya Nair: can we add a quick fast-path header "pack-skip" so upstream can opt-out? helps platforms with strict latency needs.
Ajay Patel: yes. integrate header and respond with telemetry tag. also add tracing span for "pack-decision" so we can see why a request waited or bypassed.
Maria Chen: action items: Ajay protos feature flag + header, Samir adds eviction metrics + LRU cap, Priya adds bucket EWMAs + histograms, I'll own rollout gating and comms.
infra-bot: canary deploy initiated by Maria C. config: batcher.global_buffer_ms=25, batcher.tune.bucketing=enabled. :rocket:
Ajay Patel: starting canary. will post baseline snapshots in ~30m.
Maria Chen: thanks. keep replies short in-thread. we'll reconvene with numbers. :thumbsup:
